comparison.objective: Seat a click-type torque wrench on a busbar lug bolt and tighten to the click without over-torque; candidate screens finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Socket-to-hex seating, controlled torque application, and stopping on a one-shot detent cue versus bimanual pouring, orientation-selective screening, and bridge-clearing agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Requires seated socket, click, 90–110% target torque, no unseated turning or over-torque, release, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires all feed transferred, ≥98% media recovered, every washer retained, no loss/contamination/damage, supported screen release, and 3 s dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Fastener torque control and click-cue response do not test granular separation or selective retention.
